title: Ferretti Yachts 860
highlights: Malta flag, ideal for the Mediterranean
description:
Built in 2023, this Ferretti Yachts 860 is a contemporary 88-foot flybridge yacht that balances high-performance cruising with refined Italian luxury, in lightly used condition with only 300 engine hours.

Twin MAN V12 2,000 HP engines give a fast 28-knot cruise, a 32-knot top speed and a range of around 800 nautical miles, while fin stabilisers and a Seakeeper gyro ensure comfort underway and at rest. Located in Malta and flying the Malta flag, she is ideally positioned for Mediterranean cruising.
